OmicsBase is an open-source AI workspace for omics analysis in R and Bioconductor. Ask a question in a **note** and get back R code that has already run, with its output and figures. For larger projects, **Reports** gives you your own analysis agent on the CSC Roihu supercomputer or on your own computer, from your data to a finished report.

Use it at [omicsbase.utu.fi](https://omicsbase.utu.fi), or [run it on your own machine](self-host/install.qmd).
